moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has spent 18 non-consecutive weeks at UK Number 1, matching Frankie Laine's 'I Believe' as the longest-running UK Number 1 single of all time.

angles.name: Chart Record Breakers
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is now tied for the longest-running UK Number 1 single EVER. An absolute anthem!

angles.name: Is it the best ever?
angles.copy: 18 weeks at Number 1! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean has equalled the all-time record. Does it deserve its place in the history books?
